agent.description: Sample agent: knowledge connectors over an FAQ data store and a document data store, with an intent route for human handoff.

structData.question: What are your opening hours?
structData.answer: Our support team is available Monday to Friday, 8am to 8pm UTC.

structData.question: Do you ship internationally?
structData.answer: Yes, we ship to more than 40 countries. Duties are calculated at checkout.

structData.question: How do I reset my password?
structData.answer: Use 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page and follow the link we email you.

documents.title: Returns and refunds
documents.content:
You can return any unused item within 30 days of delivery. Start a return from the Orders page and print the prepaid label.

Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days after we receive the item.

documents.title: Warranty
documents.content: Electronics carry a two year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Accidental damage and water damage are not covered.
